meta.title: Zawmo — Shot from all angles
meta.description: Capture your moment and see it through the eyes of everyone who was there.

home.lead: Every great moment is seen by more than one person. On Zawmo, all your angles meet in one place and become the whole moment.
points: Everyone adds their angle: a photo or a video up to 20 seconds
An automatic montage of every angle, ready to share
Send the link to anyone who was there, no app install needed
